```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
```

#Reading in the Predicted Concentrations
``` {r reading in the predicted concentrations}
tissue_raw <- read_excel("all_samples_predicted_conc_data_final_tissue.xlsx")

plasma_raw <- read_excel("all_samples_predicted_conc_data_final_plasma.xlsx")
```

#Separating by Metabolite
``` {r cleaning the data}
plasma_cleaned <- plasma_raw %>%
  mutate(tissue = "pl") %>%
  select(compound, tissue, treatment, pred_conc)

tissue_cleaned <- tissue_raw %>%
  select(compound, tissue, treatment, pred_conc)

all_data <- bind_rows(tissue_cleaned, plasma_cleaned)
```

``` {r preparing for TK modeling}
all_data_cleaned <- all_data %>% 
  filter(treatment != "No Exposure") %>%
  mutate(
    time = case_when(
      treatment == "0 hr" ~ 0,
      treatment == "1 hr" ~ 1,
      treatment == "2 hr" ~ 2,
      treatment == "4 hr" ~ 4,
      treatment == "8 hr" ~ 8,
      treatment == "24 hr" ~ 24
    )
  ) %>%
#Dropping the negative values, otherwise the modeling will fail
  mutate(pred_conc = ifelse(pred_conc < 0, 0, pred_conc)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pred_conc)) 

all_data_cleaned_summary <- all_data_cleaned %>%
  group_by(time, tissue, compound) %>%
  summarise(
    conc = mean(pred_conc),
    n = sum(!is.na(pred_conc)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

``` {r separating by metabolite}
dca <- all_data_cleaned %>%
  filter(compound == "DCA")

tca <- all_data_cleaned %>%
  filter(compound == "TCA")

tceoh_gluc <- all_data_cleaned %>%
  filter(compound == "TCEOH-Gluc")
```

``` {r Averaging DCA}
dca_avg <- dca %>%
  filter(treatment != "No Exposure") %>%  #removing controls
  group_by(compound, tissue, time) %>%
  summarise(
    conc = mean(pred_conc, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dca_wide <- dca_avg %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = tissue,
    values_from = conc
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Cp = pl,  #plasma
    Cl = lv,  #liver
    Cb = rb   #brain
  ) %>%
  arrange(time)
```

``` {r Averaging TCA}
tca_avg <- tca %>%
  filter(treatment != "No Exposure") %>%
  group_by(compound, tissue, time) %>%
  summarise(
    conc = mean(pred_conc, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

tca_wide <- tca_avg %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = tissue,
    values_from = conc
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Cp = pl,  
    Cl = lv,  
    Cb = rb   
  ) %>%
  arrange(time)
```

``` {r Averaging TCEOH-Gluc}
tceoh_gluc_avg <- tceoh_gluc %>%
  filter(treatment != "No Exposure") %>%
  group_by(compound, tissue, time) %>%
  summarise(
    conc = mean(pred_conc, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

tceoh_gluc_wide <- tceoh_gluc_avg %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = tissue,
    values_from = conc
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Cp = pl,  
    Cl = lv,  
    Cb = rb   
  ) %>%
  arrange(time)
```

#Compartment Models - DCA
``` {r cleaning and models - DCA}
library(deSolve)
library(dplyr)

#Clean the data
dca_wide <- dca_wide %>%
  mutate(
    Cp = ifelse(is.na(Cp), 0, Cp),
    Cl = ifelse(is.na(Cl), 0, Cl),
    Cb = ifelse(is.na(Cb), 0, Cb)
  )

#Model (liver with formation)
pk_model <- function(time, state, parms) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parms)), {
    
    #Liver formation
    formation_l <- kform_liver * time * exp(-kform_decay_liver * time)
    
    #ODEs
    dCp <- - kpl*Cp - kpb*Cp - kel*Cp + klp*Cl + kbp*Cb
    dCl <- kpl*Cp - klp*Cl + formation_l
    dCb <- kpb*Cp - kbp*Cb   #NO brain formation
    
    list(c(dCp, dCl, dCb))
  })
}
```

``` {r initial conditions and fitted parameters - DCA}
#Initial conditions
state <- c(
  Cp = dca_wide$Cp[1],
  Cl = dca_wide$Cl[1],
  Cb = dca_wide$Cb[1]
)

dca_time_points <- dca_wide$time

#Weighted cost function
cost_function_weighted <- function(pars) {
  
  parms_vector <- c(
    kpl = pars[1],
    kpb = pars[2],
    klp = pars[3],
    kbp = pars[4],
    kel = pars[5],
    kform_liver = pars[6],
    kform_decay_liver = pars[7]
  )
  
  out <- ode(
    y = state,
    times = dca_time_points,
    func = pk_model,
    parms = parms_vector
  )
  
  out_df <- as.data.frame(out)
  
  Cp_scale <- max(dca_wide$Cp, na.rm = TRUE)
  Cl_scale <- max(dca_wide$Cl, na.rm = TRUE)
  Cb_scale <- max(dca_wide$Cb, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  res <- sum(
    ((dca_wide$Cp - out_df$Cp) / Cp_scale)^2 +
    ((dca_wide$Cl - out_df$Cl) / Cl_scale)^2 +
    ((dca_wide$Cb - out_df$Cb) / Cb_scale)^2
  )
  
  return(res)
}

#Trying multiple starting values
start_list <- list(
  c(0.5, 0.5, 0.2, 0.05, 0.1, 10, 1.0),
  c(0.2, 0.3, 0.1, 0.05, 0.05, 20, 1.5),
  c(0.8, 0.2, 0.3, 0.1, 0.2, 30, 0.8),
  c(0.3, 0.8, 0.15, 0.03, 0.1, 15, 1.5),
  c(1.0, 0.4, 0.5, 0.08, 0.3, 25, 0.5),
  c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.02, 0.05, 5, 0.5),
  c(1.5, 0.6, 0.4, 0.1, 0.5, 50, 2.0),
  c(0.4, 1.0, 0.2, 0.02, 0.1, 8, 0.8),
  c(0.7, 0.3, 0.6, 0.15, 0.2, 40, 1.2),
  c(0.25, 0.6, 0.12, 0.04, 0.08, 12, 1.3)
)

fit_results <- vector("list", length(start_list))
fit_values <- rep(NA_real_, length(start_list))

for (i in seq_along(start_list)) {
  fit_try <- try(
  optim(
    par = start_list[[i]],
    fn = cost_function_weighted,
    lower = rep(0, 7),
    upper = c(10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 500, 10),
    method = "L-BFGS-B"
  ),
  silent = TRUE
)
  
  if (!inherits(fit_try, "try-error")) {
    fit_results[[i]] <- fit_try
    fit_values[i] <- fit_try$value
  }
}

#Keep best fit
best_index <- which.min(fit_values)
fit_weighted <- fit_results[[best_index]]

#Extract fitted parameters
fitted_parms <- c(
  kpl = fit_weighted$par[1],
  kpb = fit_weighted$par[2],
  klp = fit_weighted$par[3],
  kbp = fit_weighted$par[4],
  kel = fit_weighted$par[5],
  kform_liver = fit_weighted$par[6],
  kform_decay_liver = fit_weighted$par[7]
)

fitted_parms
fit_weighted$value
```

``` {r model fitting and plotting - DCA}
#Simulating the data
dca_fitted <- ode(
  y = state,
  times = dca_time_points,
  func = pk_model,
  parms = fitted_parms
)

dca_fitted_df <- as.data.frame(dca_fitted)

#Plotting
op <- par(mfrow = c(3, 1), mar = c(3, 4, 2, 1))

#Plasma
plot(dca_wide$time, dca_wide$Cp, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "black",
     xlab = "Time (hr)", ylab = "Plasma conc",
     main = "DCA Plasma")
lines(dca_fitted_df$time, dca_fitted_df$Cp, col = "black", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
legend("topright",
       legend = c("Data", "Model"),
       col = c("black", "black"),
       lty = c(1, 2), pch = c(16, NA), bty = "n")

#Liver
plot(dca_wide$time, dca_wide$Cl, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "red",
     xlab = "Time (hr)", ylab = "Liver conc",
     main = "DCA Liver")
lines(dca_fitted_df$time, dca_fitted_df$Cl, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
legend("topright",
       legend = c("Data", "Model"),
       col = c("red", "red"),
       lty = c(1, 2), pch = c(16, NA), bty = "n")

#Brain
plot(dca_wide$time, dca_wide$Cb, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "green3",
     xlab = "Time (hr)", ylab = "Brain conc",
     main = "DCA Brain")
lines(dca_fitted_df$time, dca_fitted_df$Cb, col = "green3", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
legend("topright",
       legend = c("Data", "Model"),
       col = c("green3", "green3"),
       lty = c(1, 2), pch = c(16, NA), bty = "n")

par(op)
```

``` {r model fit metrics - DCA}
#Residuals
res_plasma <- dca_wide$Cp - dca_fitted_df$Cp
res_liver  <- dca_wide$Cl - dca_fitted_df$Cl
res_brain  <- dca_wide$Cb - dca_fitted_df$Cb

#RMSE
rmse_plasma <- sqrt(mean(res_plasma^2, na.rm = TRUE))
rmse_liver  <- sqrt(mean(res_liver^2, na.rm = TRUE))
rmse_brain  <- sqrt(mean(res_brain^2, na.rm = TRUE))

#Normalized RMSE
nrmse_plasma <- rmse_plasma / max(dca_wide$Cp, na.rm = TRUE)
nrmse_liver  <- rmse_liver  / max(dca_wide$Cl, na.rm = TRUE)
nrmse_brain  <- rmse_brain  / max(dca_wide$Cb, na.rm = TRUE)

#Pseudo-R2
r2_plasma <- 1 - sum(res_plasma^2, na.rm = TRUE) / 
  sum((dca_wide$Cp - mean(dca_wide$Cp, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)

r2_liver <- 1 - sum(res_liver^2, na.rm = TRUE) / 
  sum((dca_wide$Cl - mean(dca_wide$Cl, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)

r2_brain <- 1 - sum(res_brain^2, na.rm = TRUE) / 
  sum((dca_wide$Cb - mean(dca_wide$Cb, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
```

``` {r half-life calculations - DCA}
#Plasma effective elimination rate (ALL ways Cp decreases)
k_eff_plasma <- fitted_parms["kel"] + fitted_parms["kpl"] + fitted_parms["kpb"]

t_half_plasma <- log(2) / k_eff_plasma

#Liver half-life (redistribution back to plasma)
t_half_liver <- log(2) / fitted_parms["klp"]

#Brain half-life (redistribution back to plasma)
t_half_brain <- log(2) / fitted_parms["kbp"]
```

``` {r AUC Calculations - DCA}
library(pracma)

auc_plasma <- trapz(dca_wide$time, dca_wide$Cp)
auc_liver  <- trapz(dca_wide$time, dca_wide$Cl)
auc_brain  <- trapz(dca_wide$time, dca_wide$Cb)

brain_plasma_ratio <- auc_brain / auc_plasma
liver_plasma_ratio <- auc_liver / auc_plasma
```

``` {r all values - DCA}
options(scipen = 999)
#Rate constants
dca_rate_constants_df <- tibble(
  compound = "DCA",
  parameter = names(fitted_parms),
  estimate = as.numeric(fitted_parms)
)

#Tissue summary
dca_tissue_summary_df <- tibble(
  compound = "DCA",
  tissue = c("Plasma", "Liver", "Brain"),
  half_life_hr = c(t_half_plasma, t_half_liver, t_half_brain),
  auc = c(auc_plasma, auc_liver, auc_brain),
  auc_ratio_vs_plasma = c(1, liver_plasma_ratio, brain_plasma_ratio),
  rmse = c(rmse_plasma, rmse_liver, rmse_brain),
  nrmse = c(nrmse_plasma, nrmse_liver, nrmse_brain),
  pseudo_r2 = c(r2_plasma, r2_liver, r2_brain)
)

#Overall model summary
dca_model_summary_df <- tibble(
  compound = "DCA",
  best_starting_set = best_index,
  objective_value = fit_weighted$value
)

#Combined long dataframe
dca_combined_df <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    compound = "DCA",
    section = "rate_constant",
    item = names(fitted_parms),
    tissue = NA_character_,
    value = as.numeric(fitted_parms)
  ),
  tibble(
    compound = "DCA",
    section = "tissue_summary",
    tissue = c("Plasma", "Liver", "Brain"),
    half_life_hr = c(t_half_plasma, t_half_liver, t_half_brain),
    auc = c(auc_plasma, auc_liver, auc_brain),
    auc_ratio_vs_plasma = c(1, liver_plasma_ratio, brain_plasma_ratio),
    rmse = c(rmse_plasma, rmse_liver, rmse_brain),
    nrmse = c(nrmse_plasma, nrmse_liver, nrmse_brain),
    pseudo_r2 = c(r2_plasma, r2_liver, r2_brain)
  ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(half_life_hr, auc, auc_ratio_vs_plasma, rmse, nrmse, pseudo_r2),
      names_to = "item",
      values_to = "value"
    ),
  tibble(
    compound = "DCA",
    section = "model_summary",
    item = c("best_starting_set", "objective_value"),
    tissue = NA_character_,
    value = c(best_index, fit_weighted$value)
  )
)
```

#Compartment Models - TCA
``` {r cleaning and models - TCA}
library(deSolve)
library(dplyr)

tca_wide <- tca_wide %>%
  mutate(
    Cp = ifelse(is.na(Cp), 0, Cp),
    Cl = ifelse(is.na(Cl), 0, Cl),
    Cb = ifelse(is.na(Cb), 0, Cb)
  )

#Model (plasma + liver formation only)
pk_model <- function(time, state, parms) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parms)), {

    formation_l <- kform_liver * time * exp(-kform_decay_liver * time)
    
    dCp <- - kpl*Cp - kpb*Cp - kel*Cp + klp*Cl + kbp*Cb
    dCl <- kpl*Cp - klp*Cl + formation_l
    dCb <- kpb*Cp - kbp*Cb
    
    list(c(dCp, dCl, dCb))
  })
}
```

``` {r intial conditions and fitted paramaters - TCA}
#Initial conditions
state <- c(
  Cp = tca_wide$Cp[1],
  Cl = tca_wide$Cl[1],
  Cb = tca_wide$Cb[1]
)

tca_time_points <- tca_wide$time

#Weighted cost function
cost_function_weighted <- function(pars) {
  
  parms_vector <- c(
    kpl = pars[1],
    kpb = pars[2],
    klp = pars[3],
    kbp = pars[4],
    kel = pars[5],
    kform_liver = pars[6],
    kform_decay_liver = pars[7]
  )
  
  out <- ode(
    y = state,
    times = tca_time_points,
    func = pk_model,
    parms = parms_vector
  )
  
  out_df <- as.data.frame(out)
  
  Cp_scale <- max(tca_wide$Cp, na.rm = TRUE)
  Cl_scale <- max(tca_wide$Cl, na.rm = TRUE)
  Cb_scale <- max(tca_wide$Cb, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  res <- sum(
    ((tca_wide$Cp - out_df$Cp) / Cp_scale)^2 +
    ((tca_wide$Cl - out_df$Cl) / Cl_scale)^2 +
    ((tca_wide$Cb - out_df$Cb) / Cb_scale)^2
  )
  
  return(res)
}

#Trying many start values
start_list <- list(
  c(0.5, 0.5, 0.2, 0.05, 0.1, 10, 1.0),
  c(0.2, 0.3, 0.1, 0.05, 0.05, 20, 1.5),
  c(0.8, 0.2, 0.3, 0.1, 0.2, 30, 0.8),
  c(0.3, 0.8, 0.15, 0.03, 0.1, 15, 1.5),
  c(1.0, 0.4, 0.5, 0.08, 0.3, 25, 0.5),
  c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.02, 0.05, 5, 0.5),
  c(1.5, 0.6, 0.4, 0.1, 0.5, 50, 2.0),
  c(0.4, 1.0, 0.2, 0.02, 0.1, 8, 0.8),
  c(0.7, 0.3, 0.6, 0.15, 0.2, 40, 1.2),
  c(0.25, 0.6, 0.12, 0.04, 0.08, 12, 1.3)
)

fit_results <- vector("list", length(start_list))
fit_values <- rep(NA_real_, length(start_list))

for (i in seq_along(start_list)) {
  fit_try <- try(
  optim(
    par = start_list[[i]],
    fn = cost_function_weighted,
    lower = rep(0, 7),
    upper = c(10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 500, 10),
    method = "L-BFGS-B"
  ),
  silent = TRUE
)
  
  if (!inherits(fit_try, "try-error")) {
    fit_results[[i]] <- fit_try
    fit_values[i] <- fit_try$value
  }
}

#Keep best fit
best_index <- which.min(fit_values)
fit_weighted <- fit_results[[best_index]]

#Extract fitted parameters
fitted_parms <- c(
  kpl = fit_weighted$par[1],
  kpb = fit_weighted$par[2],
  klp = fit_weighted$par[3],
  kbp = fit_weighted$par[4],
  kel = fit_weighted$par[5],
  kform_liver = fit_weighted$par[6],
  kform_decay_liver = fit_weighted$par[7]
)

fitted_parms
fit_weighted$value
```

``` {r all values - TCA}
    section = "tissue_summary",
    tissue = c("Plasma", "Liver", "Brain"),
    half_life_hr = c(t_half_plasma, t_half_liver, t_half_brain),
    auc = c(auc_plasma, auc_liver, auc_brain),
    auc_ratio_vs_plasma = c(1, liver_plasma_ratio, brain_plasma_ratio),
    rmse = c(rmse_plasma, rmse_liver, rmse_brain),
    nrmse = c(nrmse_plasma, nrmse_liver, nrmse_brain),
    pseudo_r2 = c(r2_plasma, r2_liver, r2_brain)
  ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(half_life_hr, auc, auc_ratio_vs_plasma, rmse, nrmse, pseudo_r2),
      names_to = "item",
      values_to = "value"
    ),
  tibble(
    compound = "TCA",
    section = "model_summary",
    item = c("best_starting_set", "objective_value"),
    tissue = NA_character_,
    value = c(best_index, fit_weighted$value)
  )
)
```

#Compartment Models - TCEOH-Gluc
``` {r cleaning and models - TCEOH-Gluc}
library(deSolve)
library(dplyr)

tceoh_gluc_wide <- tceoh_gluc_wide %>%
  mutate(
    Cp = ifelse(is.na(Cp), 0, Cp),
    Cl = ifelse(is.na(Cl), 0, Cl),
    Cb = ifelse(is.na(Cb), 0, Cb)
  )

#PK model with liver formation term
pk_model <- function(time, state, parms) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parms)), {
    
    formation_l <- kform_liver * time * exp(-kform_decay_liver * time)
    
    dCp <- -kpl * Cp - kpb * Cp - kel * Cp + klp * Cl + kbp * Cb
    dCl <-  kpl * Cp - klp * Cl + formation_l
    dCb <-  kpb * Cp - kbp * Cb
    
    list(c(dCp, dCl, dCb))
  })
}
```

``` {r initial conditions and fitted parameters - TCEOH-Gluc}
#Initial conditions
state <- c(
  Cp = tceoh_gluc_wide$Cp[1],
  Cl = tceoh_gluc_wide$Cl[1],
  Cb = tceoh_gluc_wide$Cb[1]
)

tceoh_gluc_time_points <- tceoh_gluc_wide$time

#Weighted cost function
cost_function_weighted <- function(pars) {
  
  parms_vector <- c(
    kpl = pars[1],
    kpb = pars[2],
    klp = pars[3],
    kbp = pars[4],
    kel = pars[5],
    kform_liver = pars[6],
    kform_decay_liver = pars[7]
  )
  
  out <- ode(
    y = state,
    times = tceoh_gluc_time_points,
    func = pk_model,
    parms = parms_vector
  )
  
  out_df <- as.data.frame(out)
  
  Cp_scale <- max(tceoh_gluc_wide$Cp, na.rm = TRUE)
  Cl_scale <- max(tceoh_gluc_wide$Cl, na.rm = TRUE)
  Cb_scale <- max(tceoh_gluc_wide$Cb, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  res <- sum(
    ((tceoh_gluc_wide$Cp - out_df$Cp) / Cp_scale)^2 +
    ((tceoh_gluc_wide$Cl - out_df$Cl) / Cl_scale)^2 +
    ((tceoh_gluc_wide$Cb - out_df$Cb) / Cb_scale)^2
  )
  
  return(res)
}

#Try multiple starting values
start_list <- list(
  c(0.5, 0.5, 0.2, 0.05, 0.1, 10, 1.0),
  c(0.2, 0.3, 0.1, 0.05, 0.05, 20, 1.5),
  c(0.8, 0.2, 0.3, 0.1, 0.2, 30, 0.8),
  c(0.3, 0.8, 0.15, 0.03, 0.1, 15, 1.5),
  c(1.0, 0.4, 0.5, 0.08, 0.3, 25, 0.5),
  c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.02, 0.05, 5, 0.5),
  c(1.5, 0.6, 0.4, 0.1, 0.5, 50, 2.0),
  c(0.4, 1.0, 0.2, 0.02, 0.1, 8, 0.8),
  c(0.7, 0.3, 0.6, 0.15, 0.2, 40, 1.2),
  c(0.25, 0.6, 0.12, 0.04, 0.08, 12, 1.3)
)

fit_results <- vector("list", length(start_list))
fit_values <- rep(NA_real_, length(start_list))

for (i in seq_along(start_list)) {
  fit_try <- try(
  optim(
    par = start_list[[i]],
    fn = cost_function_weighted,
    lower = rep(0, 7),
    upper = c(10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 500, 10),
    method = "L-BFGS-B"
  ),
  silent = TRUE
)
  
  if (!inherits(fit_try, "try-error")) {
    fit_results[[i]] <- fit_try
    fit_values[i] <- fit_try$value
  }
}

best_index <- which.min(fit_values)
fit_weighted <- fit_results[[best_index]]

#Extract fitted parameters
fitted_parms <- c(
  kpl = fit_weighted$par[1],
  kpb = fit_weighted$par[2],
  klp = fit_weighted$par[3],
  kbp = fit_weighted$par[4],
  kel = fit_weighted$par[5],
  kform_liver = fit_weighted$par[6],
  kform_decay_liver = fit_weighted$par[7]
)

fitted_parms
fit_weighted$value
```

``` {r model fitting and plotting - TCEOH-Gluc}
#Simulate the data
tceoh_gluc_fitted <- ode(
  y = state,
  times = tceoh_gluc_time_points,
  func = pk_model,
  parms = fitted_parms
)

tceoh_gluc_fitted_df <- as.data.frame(tceoh_gluc_fitted)

#Plotting
op <- par(mfrow = c(3, 1), mar = c(3, 4, 2, 1))

#Plasma
plot(tceoh_gluc_wide$time, tceoh_gluc_wide$Cp, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "black",
     xlab = "Time (hr)", ylab = "Plasma conc",

       legend = c("Data", "Model"),

#Brain

     xlab = "Time (hr)", ylab = "Brain conc",
     main = "TCEOH-Gluc Brain")
lines(tceoh_gluc_fitted_df$time, tceoh_gluc_fitted_df$Cb, col = "green3", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
```

``` {r model fit metrics - TCEOH-Gluc}
#Residuals
res_plasma <- tceoh_gluc_wide$Cp - tceoh_gluc_fitted_df$Cp
res_liver  <- tceoh_gluc_wide$Cl - tceoh_gluc_fitted_df$Cl
res_brain  <- tceoh_gluc_wide$Cb - tceoh_gluc_fitted_df$Cb

#RMSE
rmse_plasma <- sqrt(mean(res_plasma^2, na.rm = TRUE))
rmse_liver  <- sqrt(mean(res_liver^2, na.rm = TRUE))
rmse_brain  <- sqrt(mean(res_brain^2, na.rm = TRUE))

#Normalized RMSE
nrmse_plasma <- rmse_plasma / max(tceoh_gluc_wide$Cp, na.rm = TRUE)
nrmse_liver  <- rmse_liver  / max(tceoh_gluc_wide$Cl, na.rm = TRUE)
nrmse_brain  <- rmse_brain  / max(tceoh_gluc_wide$Cb, na.rm = TRUE)

#Pseudo-R2
r2_plasma <- 1 - sum(res_plasma^2, na.rm = TRUE) / 
  sum((tceoh_gluc_wide$Cp - mean(tceoh_gluc_wide$Cp, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)

r2_liver <- 1 - sum(res_liver^2, na.rm = TRUE) / 
  sum((tceoh_gluc_wide$Cl - mean(tceoh_gluc_wide$Cl, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)

r2_brain <- 1 - sum(res_brain^2, na.rm = TRUE) / 
  sum((tceoh_gluc_wide$Cb - mean(tceoh_gluc_wide$Cb, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
```

``` {r half-life calculations - TCEOH-Gluc}
k_eff_plasma <- fitted_parms["kel"] + fitted_parms["kpl"] + fitted_parms["kpb"]

t_half_plasma <- log(2) / k_eff_plasma
t_half_liver  <- log(2) / fitted_parms["klp"]
t_half_brain  <- log(2) / fitted_parms["kbp"]
```

``` {r AUC Calculations - TCEOH-Gluc}
library(pracma)

auc_plasma <- trapz(tceoh_gluc_wide$time, tceoh_gluc_wide$Cp)
auc_liver  <- trapz(tceoh_gluc_wide$time, tceoh_gluc_wide$Cl)
auc_brain  <- trapz(tceoh_gluc_wide$time, tceoh_gluc_wide$Cb)

brain_plasma_ratio <- auc_brain / auc_plasma
liver_plasma_ratio <- auc_liver / auc_plasma
```

#Sensitivity Analysis - Including Brain Formation
``` {r full code for dca with brain formation term, eval = FALSE}
library(deSolve)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(pracma)


#Cleaning and model
dca_wide <- dca_wide %>%
  mutate(
    Cp = ifelse(is.na(Cp), 0, Cp),
    Cl = ifelse(is.na(Cl), 0, Cl),
    Cb = ifelse(is.na(Cb), 0, Cb)
  )

pk_model_dca <- function(time, state, parms) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parms)), {
    
    formation_l <- kform_liver * time * exp(-kform_decay_liver * time)
    formation_b <- kform_brain * time * exp(-kform_decay_brain * time)
    
    dCp <- -kpl * Cp - kpb * Cp - kel * Cp + klp * Cl + kbp * Cb
    dCl <-  kpl * Cp - klp * Cl + formation_l
    dCb <-  kpb * Cp - kbp * Cb + formation_b
    
    list(c(dCp, dCl, dCb))
  })
}


#Initial conditions and fitting
state_dca <- c(
  Cp = dca_wide$Cp[1],
  Cl = dca_wide$Cl[1],
  Cb = dca_wide$Cb[1]
)

dca_time_points <- dca_wide$time

cost_function_weighted_dca <- function(pars) {
  
  parms_vector <- c(
    kpl = pars[1],
    kpb = pars[2],
    klp = pars[3],
    kbp = pars[4],
    kel = pars[5],
    kform_liver = pars[6],
    kform_decay_liver = pars[7],
    kform_brain = pars[8],
    kform_decay_brain = pars[9]
  )
  
  out <- ode(
    y = state_dca,
    times = dca_time_points,
    func = pk_model_dca,
    parms = parms_vector
  )
  
  out_df <- as.data.frame(out)
  
  Cp_scale <- max(dca_wide$Cp, na.rm = TRUE)
  Cl_scale <- max(dca_wide$Cl, na.rm = TRUE)
  Cb_scale <- max(dca_wide$Cb, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  sum(
    ((dca_wide$Cp - out_df$Cp) / Cp_scale)^2 +
    ((dca_wide$Cl - out_df$Cl) / Cl_scale)^2 +
    ((dca_wide$Cb - out_df$Cb) / Cb_scale)^2
  )
}

start_list_dca <- list(
  c(0.5, 0.5, 0.2, 0.05, 0.1, 10, 1.0, 1, 1.0),
  c(0.2, 0.3, 0.1, 0.05, 0.05, 20, 1.5, 2, 1.5),
  c(0.8, 0.2, 0.3, 0.1, 0.2, 30, 0.8, 3, 0.8),
  c(0.3, 0.8, 0.15, 0.03, 0.1, 15, 1.5, 1.5, 1.2),
  c(1.0, 0.4, 0.5, 0.08, 0.3, 25, 0.5, 2.5, 0.5),
  c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.02, 0.05, 5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
  c(1.5, 0.6, 0.4, 0.1, 0.5, 50, 2.0, 5, 2.0),
  c(0.4, 1.0, 0.2, 0.02, 0.1, 8, 0.8, 1, 0.8),
  c(0.7, 0.3, 0.6, 0.15, 0.2, 40, 1.2, 4, 1.2),
  c(0.25, 0.6, 0.12, 0.04, 0.08, 12, 1.3, 1.2, 1.3)
)

fit_results_dca <- vector("list", length(start_list_dca))
fit_values_dca <- rep(NA_real_, length(start_list_dca))

for (i in seq_along(start_list_dca)) {
  fit_try <- try(
    optim(
      par = start_list_dca[[i]],
      fn = cost_function_weighted_dca,
      lower = rep(0, 9),
      upper = c(10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 500, 10, 500, 10),
      method = "L-BFGS-B"
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  if (!inherits(fit_try, "try-error")) {
    fit_results_dca[[i]] <- fit_try
    fit_values_dca[i] <- fit_try$value
  }
}

best_index_dca <- which.min(fit_values_dca)
fit_weighted_dca <- fit_results_dca[[best_index_dca]]

fitted_parms_dca <- c(
  kpl = fit_weighted_dca$par[1],
  kpb = fit_weighted_dca$par[2],
  klp = fit_weighted_dca$par[3],
  kbp = fit_weighted_dca$par[4],
  kel = fit_weighted_dca$par[5],
  kform_liver = fit_weighted_dca$par[6],
  kform_decay_liver = fit_weighted_dca$par[7],
  kform_brain = fit_weighted_dca$par[8],
  kform_decay_brain = fit_weighted_dca$par[9]
)

fitted_parms_dca
fit_weighted_dca$value

#Model fitting and plotting
dca_fitted <- ode(
  y = state_dca,
  times = dca_time_points,
  func = pk_model_dca,
  parms = fitted_parms_dca
)

dca_fitted_df <- as.data.frame(dca_fitted)

op <- par(mfrow = c(3, 1), mar = c(4, 5, 3, 2))

plot(dca_wide$time, dca_wide$Cp, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "black",
     xlab = "Time (hr)", ylab = "Plasma conc", main = "DCA Plasma")
lines(dca_fitted_df$time, dca_fitted_df$Cp, col = "black", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("Data", "Model"),
       col = c("black", "black"), lty = c(1, 2), pch = c(16, NA), bty = "n")

plot(dca_wide$time, dca_wide$Cl, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "red",
     xlab = "Time (hr)", ylab = "Liver conc", main = "DCA Liver")
lines(dca_fitted_df$time, dca_fitted_df$Cl, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("Data", "Model"),
       col = c("red", "red"), lty = c(1, 2), pch = c(16, NA), bty = "n")

plot(dca_wide$time, dca_wide$Cb, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "green3",
     xlab = "Time (hr)", ylab = "Brain conc", main = "DCA Brain")
lines(dca_fitted_df$time, dca_fitted_df$Cb, col = "green3", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("Data", "Model"),
       col = c("green3", "green3"), lty = c(1, 2), pch = c(16, NA), bty = "n")

par(op)

#Model fit metrics
res_plasma_dca <- dca_wide$Cp - dca_fitted_df$Cp
res_liver_dca  <- dca_wide$Cl - dca_fitted_df$Cl
res_brain_dca  <- dca_wide$Cb - dca_fitted_df$Cb

rmse_plasma_dca <- sqrt(mean(res_plasma_dca^2, na.rm = TRUE))
rmse_liver_dca  <- sqrt(mean(res_liver_dca^2, na.rm = TRUE))
rmse_brain_dca  <- sqrt(mean(res_brain_dca^2, na.rm = TRUE))

nrmse_plasma_dca <- rmse_plasma_dca / max(dca_wide$Cp, na.rm = TRUE)
nrmse_liver_dca  <- rmse_liver_dca  / max(dca_wide$Cl, na.rm = TRUE)
nrmse_brain_dca  <- rmse_brain_dca  / max(dca_wide$Cb, na.rm = TRUE)

r2_plasma_dca <- 1 - sum(res_plasma_dca^2, na.rm = TRUE) /
  sum((dca_wide$Cp - mean(dca_wide$Cp, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)

r2_liver_dca <- 1 - sum(res_liver_dca^2, na.rm = TRUE) /
  sum((dca_wide$Cl - mean(dca_wide$Cl, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)

r2_brain_dca <- 1 - sum(res_brain_dca^2, na.rm = TRUE) /
  sum((dca_wide$Cb - mean(dca_wide$Cb, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)

#Half-life calculations
k_eff_plasma_dca <- fitted_parms_dca["kel"] + fitted_parms_dca["kpl"] + fitted_parms_dca["kpb"]

t_half_plasma_dca <- log(2) / k_eff_plasma_dca
t_half_liver_dca  <- log(2) / fitted_parms_dca["klp"]
t_half_brain_dca  <- log(2) / fitted_parms_dca["kbp"]

#AUC calculations
auc_plasma_dca <- trapz(dca_wide$time, dca_wide$Cp)
auc_liver_dca  <- trapz(dca_wide$time, dca_wide$Cl)
auc_brain_dca  <- trapz(dca_wide$time, dca_wide$Cb)

brain_plasma_ratio_dca <- auc_brain_dca / auc_plasma_dca
liver_plasma_ratio_dca <- auc_liver_dca / auc_plasma_dca

#All values
options(scipen = 999)

dca_rate_constants_df <- tibble(
  compound = "DCA",
  parameter = names(fitted_parms_dca),
  estimate = as.numeric(fitted_parms_dca)
)

  half_life_hr = c(t_half_plasma_dca, t_half_liver_dca, t_half_brain_dca),

  nrmse = c(nrmse_plasma_dca, nrmse_liver_dca, nrmse_brain_dca),
  pseudo_r2 = c(r2_plasma_dca, r2_liver_dca, r2_brain_dca)

  objective_value = fit_weighted_dca$value

dca_combined_df <- bind_rows(

    tissue = NA_character_,

  ),
  tibble(
    compound = "DCA",
    section = "tissue_summary",
    tissue = c("Plasma", "Liver", "Brain"),
    half_life_hr = c(t_half_plasma_dca, t_half_liver_dca, t_half_brain_dca),
    auc = c(auc_plasma_dca, auc_liver_dca, auc_brain_dca),
    auc_ratio_vs_plasma = c(1, liver_plasma_ratio_dca, brain_plasma_ratio_dca),
    rmse = c(rmse_plasma_dca, rmse_liver_dca, rmse_brain_dca),
    nrmse = c(nrmse_plasma_dca, nrmse_liver_dca, nrmse_brain_dca),
    pseudo_r2 = c(r2_plasma_dca, r2_liver_dca, r2_brain_dca)
```

``` {r full code for tca with brain formation term, eval = FALSE}
#Cleaning and model
tca_wide <- tca_wide %>%
  mutate(
    Cp = ifelse(is.na(Cp), 0, Cp),
    Cl = ifelse(is.na(Cl), 0, Cl),
    Cb = ifelse(is.na(Cb), 0, Cb)
  )

pk_model_tca <- function(time, state, parms) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parms)), {
    
    formation_l <- kform_liver * time * exp(-kform_decay_liver * time)
    formation_b <- kform_brain * time * exp(-kform_decay_brain * time)
    
    dCp <- -kpl * Cp - kpb * Cp - kel * Cp + klp * Cl + kbp * Cb
    dCl <-  kpl * Cp - klp * Cl + formation_l
    dCb <-  kpb * Cp - kbp * Cb + formation_b
    
    list(c(dCp, dCl, dCb))
  })
}

#Initial conditions and fitting
state_tca <- c(
  Cp = tca_wide$Cp[1],
  Cl = tca_wide$Cl[1],
  Cb = tca_wide$Cb[1]
)

tca_time_points <- tca_wide$time

cost_function_weighted_tca <- function(pars) {
  
  parms_vector <- c(
    kpl = pars[1],
    kpb = pars[2],
    klp = pars[3],
    kbp = pars[4],
    kel = pars[5],
    kform_liver = pars[6],
    kform_decay_liver = pars[7],
    kform_brain = pars[8],
    kform_decay_brain = pars[9]
  )
  
  out <- ode(
    y = state_tca,
    times = tca_time_points,
    func = pk_model_tca,
    parms = parms_vector
  )
  
  out_df <- as.data.frame(out)
  
  Cp_scale <- max(tca_wide$Cp, na.rm = TRUE)
  Cl_scale <- max(tca_wide$Cl, na.rm = TRUE)
  Cb_scale <- max(tca_wide$Cb, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  sum(
    ((tca_wide$Cp - out_df$Cp) / Cp_scale)^2 +
    ((tca_wide$Cl - out_df$Cl) / Cl_scale)^2 +
    ((tca_wide$Cb - out_df$Cb) / Cb_scale)^2
  )
}

start_list_tca <- list(
  c(0.5, 0.5, 0.2, 0.05, 0.1, 10, 1.0, 1, 1.0),
  c(0.2, 0.3, 0.1, 0.05, 0.05, 20, 1.5, 2, 1.5),
  c(0.8, 0.2, 0.3, 0.1, 0.2, 30, 0.8, 3, 0.8),
  c(0.3, 0.8, 0.15, 0.03, 0.1, 15, 1.5, 1.5, 1.2),
  c(1.0, 0.4, 0.5, 0.08, 0.3, 25, 0.5, 2.5, 0.5),
  c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.02, 0.05, 5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
  c(1.5, 0.6, 0.4, 0.1, 0.5, 50, 2.0, 5, 2.0),
  c(0.4, 1.0, 0.2, 0.02, 0.1, 8, 0.8, 1, 0.8),
  c(0.7, 0.3, 0.6, 0.15, 0.2, 40, 1.2, 4, 1.2),
  c(0.25, 0.6, 0.12, 0.04, 0.08, 12, 1.3, 1.2, 1.3)
)

fit_results_tca <- vector("list", length(start_list_tca))
fit_values_tca <- rep(NA_real_, length(start_list_tca))

for (i in seq_along(start_list_tca)) {
  fit_try <- try(
    optim(
      par = start_list_tca[[i]],
      fn = cost_function_weighted_tca,
      lower = rep(0, 9),
      upper = c(10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 500, 10, 500, 10),
      method = "L-BFGS-B"
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  if (!inherits(fit_try, "try-error")) {
    fit_results_tca[[i]] <- fit_try
    fit_values_tca[i] <- fit_try$value
  }
}

best_index_tca <- which.min(fit_values_tca)
fit_weighted_tca <- fit_results_tca[[best_index_tca]]

fitted_parms_tca <- c(
  kpl = fit_weighted_tca$par[1],
  kpb = fit_weighted_tca$par[2],
  klp = fit_weighted_tca$par[3],
  kbp = fit_weighted_tca$par[4],
  kel = fit_weighted_tca$par[5],
  kform_liver = fit_weighted_tca$par[6],
  kform_decay_liver = fit_weighted_tca$par[7],
  kform_brain = fit_weighted_tca$par[8],
  kform_decay_brain = fit_weighted_tca$par[9]
)

fitted_parms_tca
fit_weighted_tca$value

#Model fitting and plotting
tca_fitted <- ode(
  y = state_tca,
  times = tca_time_points,
  func = pk_model_tca,
  parms = fitted_parms_tca
)

tca_fitted_df <- as.data.frame(tca_fitted)

op <- par(mfrow = c(3, 1), mar = c(4, 5, 3, 2))

plot(tca_wide$time, tca_wide$Cp, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "black",
     xlab = "Time (hr)", ylab = "Plasma conc", main = "TCA Plasma")
lines(tca_fitted_df$time, tca_fitted_df$Cp, col = "black", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("Data", "Model"),
       col = c("black", "black"), lty = c(1, 2), pch = c(16, NA), bty = "n")

plot(tca_wide$time, tca_wide$Cl, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "red",
     xlab = "Time (hr)", ylab = "Liver conc", main = "TCA Liver")
lines(tca_fitted_df$time, tca_fitted_df$Cl, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("Data", "Model"),
       col = c("red", "red"), lty = c(1, 2), pch = c(16, NA), bty = "n")

plot(tca_wide$time, tca_wide$Cb, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "green3",
     xlab = "Time (hr)", ylab = "Brain conc", main = "TCA Brain")
lines(tca_fitted_df$time, tca_fitted_df$Cb, col = "green3", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("Data", "Model"),
       col = c("green3", "green3"), lty = c(1, 2), pch = c(16, NA), bty = "n")

par(op)

#Model fit metrics
res_plasma_tca <- tca_wide$Cp - tca_fitted_df$Cp
res_liver_tca  <- tca_wide$Cl - tca_fitted_df$Cl
res_brain_tca  <- tca_wide$Cb - tca_fitted_df$Cb

rmse_plasma_tca <- sqrt(mean(res_plasma_tca^2, na.rm = TRUE))
rmse_liver_tca  <- sqrt(mean(res_liver_tca^2, na.rm = TRUE))
rmse_brain_tca  <- sqrt(mean(res_brain_tca^2, na.rm = TRUE))

nrmse_plasma_tca <- rmse_plasma_tca / max(tca_wide$Cp, na.rm = TRUE)
nrmse_liver_tca  <- rmse_liver_tca  / max(tca_wide$Cl, na.rm = TRUE)
nrmse_brain_tca  <- rmse_brain_tca  / max(tca_wide$Cb, na.rm = TRUE)

r2_plasma_tca <- 1 - sum(res_plasma_tca^2, na.rm = TRUE) /
  sum((tca_wide$Cp - mean(tca_wide$Cp, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)

r2_liver_tca <- 1 - sum(res_liver_tca^2, na.rm = TRUE) /
  sum((tca_wide$Cl - mean(tca_wide$Cl, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)

r2_brain_tca <- 1 - sum(res_brain_tca^2, na.rm = TRUE) /
  sum((tca_wide$Cb - mean(tca_wide$Cb, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)

#Half-life calculations
k_eff_plasma_tca <- fitted_parms_tca["kel"] + fitted_parms_tca["kpl"] + fitted_parms_tca["kpb"]

t_half_plasma_tca <- log(2) / k_eff_plasma_tca
t_half_liver_tca  <- log(2) / fitted_parms_tca["klp"]
t_half_brain_tca  <- log(2) / fitted_parms_tca["kbp"]

#AUC calculations
auc_plasma_tca <- trapz(tca_wide$time, tca_wide$Cp)
auc_liver_tca  <- trapz(tca_wide$time, tca_wide$Cl)
auc_brain_tca  <- trapz(tca_wide$time, tca_wide$Cb)

brain_plasma_ratio_tca <- auc_brain_tca / auc_plasma_tca
liver_plasma_ratio_tca <- auc_liver_tca / auc_plasma_tca

#All values
tca_rate_constants_df <- tibble(
  compound = "TCA",
  parameter = names(fitted_parms_tca),
  estimate = as.numeric(fitted_parms_tca)
)

tca_tissue_summary_df <- tibble(
  compound = "TCA",
  tissue = c("Plasma", "Liver", "Brain"),
  half_life_hr = c(t_half_plasma_tca, t_half_liver_tca, t_half_brain_tca),
  auc = c(auc_plasma_tca, auc_liver_tca, auc_brain_tca),
  auc_ratio_vs_plasma = c(1, liver_plasma_ratio_tca, brain_plasma_ratio_tca),
  rmse = c(rmse_plasma_tca, rmse_liver_tca, rmse_brain_tca),
  nrmse = c(nrmse_plasma_tca, nrmse_liver_tca, nrmse_brain_tca),
  pseudo_r2 = c(r2_plasma_tca, r2_liver_tca, r2_brain_tca)
)

tca_model_summary_df <- tibble(
  compound = "TCA",
  best_starting_set = best_index_tca,
  objective_value = fit_weighted_tca$value
)

tca_combined_df <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    compound = "TCA",
    section = "rate_constant",
    item = names(fitted_parms_tca),
    tissue = NA_character_,
    value = as.numeric(fitted_parms_tca)
  ),
  tibble(
    compound = "TCA",
    section = "tissue_summary",
    tissue = c("Plasma", "Liver", "Brain"),
    half_life_hr = c(t_half_plasma_tca, t_half_liver_tca, t_half_brain_tca),
    auc = c(auc_plasma_tca, auc_liver_tca, auc_brain_tca),
    auc_ratio_vs_plasma = c(1, liver_plasma_ratio_tca, brain_plasma_ratio_tca),
    rmse = c(rmse_plasma_tca, rmse_liver_tca, rmse_brain_tca),
    nrmse = c(nrmse_plasma_tca, nrmse_liver_tca, nrmse_brain_tca),
    pseudo_r2 = c(r2_plasma_tca, r2_liver_tca, r2_brain_tca)
  ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(half_life_hr, auc, auc_ratio_vs_plasma, rmse, nrmse, pseudo_r2),
      names_to = "item",

    ),
  tibble(

    section = "model_summary",

  )
)
```

``` {r full code for tceoh-gluc with brain formation term, eval = FALSE}
k_eff_plasma_tceoh_gluc <- fitted_parms_tceoh_gluc["kel"] + fitted_parms_tceoh_gluc["kpl"] + fitted_parms_tceoh_gluc["kpb"]

t_half_plasma_tceoh_gluc <- log(2) / k_eff_plasma_tceoh_gluc
t_half_liver_tceoh_gluc  <- log(2) / fitted_parms_tceoh_gluc["klp"]
t_half_brain_tceoh_gluc  <- log(2) / fitted_parms_tceoh_gluc["kbp"]

#AUC calculations
auc_plasma_tceoh_gluc <- trapz(tceoh_gluc_wide$time, tceoh_gluc_wide$Cp)
auc_liver_tceoh_gluc  <- trapz(tceoh_gluc_wide$time, tceoh_gluc_wide$Cl)
auc_brain_tceoh_gluc  <- trapz(tceoh_gluc_wide$time, tceoh_gluc_wide$Cb)

brain_plasma_ratio_tceoh_gluc <- auc_brain_tceoh_gluc / auc_plasma_tceoh_gluc
liver_plasma_ratio_tceoh_gluc <- auc_liver_tceoh_gluc / auc_plasma_tceoh_gluc

#All values
tceoh_gluc_rate_constants_df <- tibble(
  compound = "TCEOH-Gluc",
  parameter = names(fitted_parms_tceoh_gluc),
  estimate = as.numeric(fitted_parms_tceoh_gluc)
)

tceoh_gluc_tissue_summary_df <- tibble(
  compound = "TCEOH-Gluc",
  tissue = c("Plasma", "Liver", "Brain"),
  half_life_hr = c(t_half_plasma_tceoh_gluc, t_half_liver_tceoh_gluc, t_half_brain_tceoh_gluc),
  auc = c(auc_plasma_tceoh_gluc, auc_liver_tceoh_gluc, auc_brain_tceoh_gluc),
  auc_ratio_vs_plasma = c(1, liver_plasma_ratio_tceoh_gluc, brain_plasma_ratio_tceoh_gluc),
  rmse = c(rmse_plasma_tceoh_gluc, rmse_liver_tceoh_gluc, rmse_brain_tceoh_gluc),
  nrmse = c(nrmse_plasma_tceoh_gluc, nrmse_liver_tceoh_gluc, nrmse_brain_tceoh_gluc),
  pseudo_r2 = c(r2_plasma_tceoh_gluc, r2_liver_tceoh_gluc, r2_brain_tceoh_gluc)
)

tceoh_gluc_model_summary_df <- tibble(
  compound = "TCEOH-Gluc",
  best_starting_set = best_index_tceoh_gluc,
  objective_value = fit_weighted_tceoh_gluc$value
)

tceoh_gluc_combined_df <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    compound = "TCEOH-Gluc",
    section = "rate_constant",
    item = names(fitted_parms_tceoh_gluc),
    tissue = NA_character_,
    value = as.numeric(fitted_parms_tceoh_gluc)
  ),
  tibble(
    compound = "TCEOH-Gluc",
    section = "tissue_summary",
    tissue = c("Plasma", "Liver", "Brain"),
    half_life_hr = c(t_half_plasma_tceoh_gluc, t_half_liver_tceoh_gluc, t_half_brain_tceoh_gluc),
    auc = c(auc_plasma_tceoh_gluc, auc_liver_tceoh_gluc, auc_brain_tceoh_gluc),
    auc_ratio_vs_plasma = c(1, liver_plasma_ratio_tceoh_gluc, brain_plasma_ratio_tceoh_gluc),
    rmse = c(rmse_plasma_tceoh_gluc, rmse_liver_tceoh_gluc, rmse_brain_tceoh_gluc),
    nrmse = c(nrmse_plasma_tceoh_gluc, nrmse_liver_tceoh_gluc, nrmse_brain_tceoh_gluc),
    pseudo_r2 = c(r2_plasma_tceoh_gluc, r2_liver_tceoh_gluc, r2_brain_tceoh_gluc)
  ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(half_life_hr, auc, auc_ratio_vs_plasma, rmse, nrmse, pseudo_r2),
      names_to = "item",
      values_to = "value"
    ),
  tibble(
    compound = "TCEOH-Gluc",
    section = "model_summary",
    item = c("best_starting_set", "objective_value"),
    tissue = NA_character_,
    value = c(best_index_tceoh_gluc, fit_weighted_tceoh_gluc$value)
  )
)

```

``` {r adding the data to one dataframe, eval = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

#Observed data
obs_long <- bind_rows(
  dca_wide %>% mutate(compound = "DCA"),
  tca_wide %>% mutate(compound = "TCA"),
  tceoh_gluc_wide %>% mutate(compound = "TCEOH-Gluc")
) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Cp, Cl, Cb),
               names_to = "tissue",
               values_to = "conc") %>%
  mutate(type = "Data") %>%
  mutate(
    type = "Data",
    tissue = recode(tissue,
                    "Cp" = "Plasma",
                    "Cl" = "Liver",
                    "Cb" = "Brain"),
    tissue = factor(tissue, levels = c("Liver", "Plasma", "Brain"))
  )

#Model data
model_long <- bind_rows(
  dca_fitted_df %>% mutate(compound = "DCA"),
  tca_fitted_df %>% mutate(compound = "TCA"),
  tceoh_gluc_fitted_df %>% mutate(compound = "TCEOH-Gluc")
) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Cp, Cl, Cb),
               names_to = "tissue",
               values_to = "conc") %>%
  mutate(type = "Model") %>%
  mutate(
    type = "Model",
    tissue = recode(tissue,
                    "Cp" = "Plasma",
                    "Cl" = "Liver",
                    "Cb" = "Brain"),
    tissue = factor(tissue, levels = c("Liver", "Plasma", "Brain"))
  )

#Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(obs_long, model_long)
```

``` {r plot, eval = FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = time, y = conc, color = tissue)) +
  
  #Observed data (points + solid lines)
  geom_point(
    data = subset(plot_df, type == "Data")
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = subset(plot_df, type == "Data"),
    aes(group = interaction(compound, tissue))
  ) +
  
  #Model (ONLY dashed line)
  geom_line(
    data = subset(plot_df, type == "Model"),
    aes(group = interaction(compound, tissue)),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  
  ggh4x::facet_grid2(compound ~ tissue, scales = "free_y", independent = "y") +
  scale_x_continuous(
  breaks = seq(0, 24, by = 4),
  limits = c(0, 25)
) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Plasma" = "#000000",
    "Liver"  = "#0000FF",
    "Brain"  = "#F50717"
  )) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Time (hr)",
    y = "Concentration (uM)",
    title = "Toxicokinetic Profiles Across Compounds and Tissues"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "tk_profiles_brain.jpeg",
  plot = last_plot(), 
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```
